## Verification evidence
- [ ] Real tests pass on the PR head.
- [ ] Build, lint, static and documentation checks pass where configured.
- [ ] Success, boundary and failure behavior are covered where applicable.
- [ ] Any manual verification includes exact environment and steps.
- [ ] No fabricated test, metric, screenshot or capability claim is used.

## Security and compatibility
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data or machine-specific paths are committed.
- [ ] Permissions and dependencies were reviewed when changed.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration and destructive-operation risks were considered.

## Documentation and release
- [ ] README and guides match the delivered state.
- [ ] Screenshots show the actual application; diagrams are labelled.
- [ ] Known limitations and remaining debt are documented.

## Risk and rollback
**Risk:** Low / Moderate / High / Critical  
**Migration:** None / Describe  
**Rollback:** Not required / Describe  
**Known limitations:** <!-- State explicitly. -->

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Scope is focused and full diff has been reviewed.
- [ ] Required checks pass and blocking review threads are resolved.
- [ ] Documentation does not overstate implementation.
